suggestions.rationale: Rare infectious complication only. Publish only with documented adrenal histoplasmosis and independently documented Addison disease/primary adrenal insufficiency. Pulmonary histoplasmosis alone does not satisfy this guard; exclude central/pituitary/hypothalamic and glucocorticoid-induced adrenal insufficiency; do not generalize to all histoplasmosis.
evidenceGaps: Independent diagnoses of Actinomycosis and Pericarditis / Endocarditis / Myocarditis
Chronology compatible with the bounded source proposition
Assessment of shared risk factors, reverse direction, treatment effects, and other competing causes
Qualified clinical opinion before using population-level evidence as an individual nexus
